env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^address provenance ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/addrprov

go 1.27

require example.com/foreign v0.0.0

replace example.com/foreign => ./foreign

-- w/foreign/go.mod --
module example.com/foreign

go 1.27

-- w/foreign/f.go --
package f

type N int

func (n N) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte("text"), nil
}

func (n *N) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(`"ptr"`), nil
}

type Payload struct {
	Value any `json:"value"`
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/foreign"
)

type Box struct {
	B f.N `json:"B"`
}

type Root struct {
	Static  Box       `json:"static"`
	Dynamic f.Payload `json:"dynamic"`
}

func mirror(dynamic any) any {
	return struct {
		Static struct {
			B f.N `json:"B"`
		} `json:"static"`
		Dynamic struct {
			Value any `json:"value"`
		} `json:"dynamic"`
	}{
		Static: struct {
			B f.N `json:"B"`
		}{B: 7},
		Dynamic: struct {
			Value any `json:"value"`
		}{Value: dynamic},
	}
}

func check(label string, root Root, oracle any) bool {
	got, gerr := root.MarshalJSON()
	if gerr != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL", label, "generated marshal:", gerr)
		return false
	}
	want, werr := json.Marshal(oracle)
	if werr != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL", label, "oracle marshal:", werr)
		return false
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		fmt.Printf("FAIL %s got=%s want=%s\n", label, got, want)
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func main() {
	box := Box{B: 7}
	if !check("static", Root{Static: box}, mirror(nil)) {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if !check("dynamic-slice",
		Root{Static: box, Dynamic: f.Payload{Value: []Box{{B: 7}}}},
		mirror([]struct{ B f.N `json:"B"` }{{B: 7}})) {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if !check("dynamic-array-pointer",
		Root{Static: box, Dynamic: f.Payload{Value: &[1]Box{{B: 7}}}},
		mirror(&[1]struct{ B f.N `json:"B"` }{{B: 7}})) {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if !check("dynamic-map",
		Root{Static: box, Dynamic: f.Payload{Value: map[string]Box{"k": {B: 7}}}},
		mirror(map[string]struct{ B f.N `json:"B"` }{"k": {B: 7}})) {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("address provenance ok")
}
